brief:
Hamas official Bassem Naim told Reuters that the son of Palestinian group leader Khalil al-Hayya survived an Israeli assassination attempt at dawn on Friday, according to Middle East Eye. The official did not provide additional details about the incident or the condition of al-Hayya's son.

The claim could not be independently verified. Israeli military operations in Gaza have intensified in recent months, with numerous reported strikes on Hamas leadership and facilities.
dek: Hamas says son of leader Khalil al-Hayya survived Israeli attack Hamas official Bassem Naim has told Reuters that the son of the Palestinian group's leader Khalil al-Hayya survived an Israeli assassination attempt at dawn on Friday.
title: Hamas official says Israeli airstrike fails to kill leader's son
